manaNeeded: {4}{R}{W}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay for commander tax, if applicable
description:
Cast Mondrak by paying {2}{W}{W}.
When Mondrak enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create two token copies of Mondrak with haste.
Cast Pia Nalaar either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {R}{W} plus commander tax, if applicable.
When Pia Nalaar enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create eight token copies of Pia Nalaar with haste.
Activate Prosperous Partnership by tapping three creatures, creating eight Treasure tokens.
Activate Professional Face-Breaker by sacrificing a Treasure, causing you to exile the top card of your library with the ability to cast it this turn.
Repeat steps 5 and 6 as required until you exile a nonland card and have enough Treasures to cast it.
Activate any number of Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding enough mana to cast the nonland card.
Cast the nonland card from exile by paying its mana cost.
Each Pia Nalaar triggers, creating a total of 72 1/1 Thopter artifact creature tokens with haste.
You may optionally repeat from step 5 as desired/able, or you may use Prosperous Partnership to tap the Thopter tokens and make up to 184 Treasure tokens.
